request.description:
Request to register a valid user. Has a birthdate indicating being at least 18 years old, and is a French resident.

Should return '201 Created' and the entity that has been added.

Request to try registering a user with a username that already exists in the database.

Should return a '409 Conflict' and an error message with code "USERNAME_EXCEPTION".

Request to try registering a user with a missing property 'username'.

Should return a '400 Bad Request' and an error message with code "VALIDATION_ERROR".

Request to try registering a user with a missing property 'birthdate'.

Should return a '400 Bad Request' and an error message with code "VALIDATION_ERROR".

Request to try registering a user with a missing property 'countryOfResidence'.

Should return a '400 Bad Request' and an error message with code "VALIDATION_ERROR".

Request to try registering a user with a birthdate not following the ISO-8601 format (yyyy-mm-dd).

Should return a '400 Bad Request' and an error message with code "VALIDATION_ERROR".

item.name: Register user: invalid country code format

request.description:
Request to try registering a user with a country code not following the ISO-3166 ALPHA3 format (USA, FRA, etc.).

Should return a '400 Bad Request' and an error message with code "VALIDATION_ERROR".

item.name: Register user: age not equal to or above 18

request.description:
Request to try registering a user that is not a legal adult yet (according to France laws, 18+).

Should return a '403 Forbidden' and an error message with code "AGE_EXCEPTION".

item.name: Register user: not a French resident

request.description:
Request to try registering a user that is not a French resident.

Should return a '403 Forbidden' and an error message with code "COUNTRY_EXCEPTION".

item.name: View user by username: existing user

request.description:
Request to view user info given a username.

Should return '302 Found' along with the user information.

item.name: View user by username: non-existing user

request.description:
Request to view user info given a username that does not exist.

Should return '404 Not Found' along with code 'USER_NOT_FOUND'.
